Package neqsim.process.util.mercury

Class MercuryProcessAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.mercury.MercuryProcessAnalyzer
public final class MercuryProcessAnalyzer extends Object
Tracks mercury through a calculated process.

Use it with a fluid that holds the component mercury, normally SystemUMRPRUMCEos. The process calculation itself distributes mercury between gas, oil and water in every separation with the equation of state. This class adds what the process calculation does not give:

  • analyze(ProcessSystem) reports the mercury flow, the mercury concentration in each phase, the degree of mercury saturation and the free liquid or solid mercury of every stream, and the mercury balance of every unit operation and of the process.
  • setFreeMercuryAccumulation(ProcessSystem, boolean) makes the separators hold back free mercury, so that the streams after a separator carry no more mercury than they dissolve.

Streams are found from the inlet and outlet streams that the unit operations report. A stream that no unit operation produces is a feed, and a stream that no unit operation uses is a product.
